fact: The Eswatini Trade Portal states company registration runs as a six-step process, from name search to certificate, available online through the government portal online.gov.sz and processed within one day.

Commerce Minister Manqoba Khumalo said the business registry has been digitised and a Business One-Stop Shop established, improving the time, efficiency and cost of registration; online registration is not stated.
system: Business One-Stop Shop and digitised business registry

fact: Trade Minister Manqoba Khumalo, reported by the Eswatini Observer, cites the Business One-Stop Shop (BOSS) initiative as streamlining business registration, licensing, taxation and trade facilitation.
Eswatini Positive News reports that the Government-In-Your-Hand app, launched in May 2025, lets entrepreneurs register and manage businesses from home, per the ICT ministry.

The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Trade's second-quarter 2026/27 performance report says 632 applicants used the online company registration service in the quarter to September 2026, against 2,127 a year earlier.
